wording_review: All sixteen designated keys, explanations and guide transfer solutions agree with the stated profiles.
Every comparison uses equally weighted complete strict ballots, no abstention or exhaustion; denominators and strict majority thresholds are explicit.
Top-two runoff is explicitly defined and distinguished from general repeated elimination; relevant ties and no-winner cases remain unresolved without extra rules.

Borda zero-to-one shift adds the same number of ballots to every candidate and preserves ties and differences. Pairwise-count identity is per-ballot alternatives below, not count of pairwise victories.
Profile P separates plurality A, runoff C, Borda B and Condorcet B; removal of C preserves A/B relative preferences but changes the alternative set.
Profile Q has cyclic strict majorities, Borda tie A/B and agenda-dependent survivors; no claim of cycle prevalence or a general impossibility theorem.

Primary-source descriptions checked directly: CMU pages1-2 support plurality/top-two runoff/Borda conventions; MIT pages2-4 and9 support three-option cycle and strict Condorcet definition. Guide correctly limits scope and does not adopt broader source theorems or CMU completion rule.
limitations: No independent native UI, learner validation, learning-efficacy or licensing-ownership certification. Author tests reviewed but not rerun; this receipt is independent mathematical/content review only.
